chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad from someone else from Aban from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding the Word of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'unless you speak in a goodly manner.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'He meets her, so he says, 'I have a desire in you, and I am honourable to the women, so do not precede me (before someone else) with yourself,' and the secret is that he should not be alone with her when he promises her.'
ai.seo_question: What does 'speaking in a goodly manner' mean in the context of a widow's waiting period?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) interprets the phrase 'goodly manner' in Surah Al-Baqarah as a man expressing his desire and respect for the widow while avoiding secret proposals (khifa) that might cause confusion or rivalry. The hadith further advises against seclusion (khalwah) with her during this period, emphasizing modesty and clarity in courtship. This reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on balancing natural desire with social propriety during the 'iddah period.

en.hubeali: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad, from someone else, from Aban, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Abdullah,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Word of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [2:235] unless you speak in a goodly manner. Heasws said: ‘He meets her, so he is saying, ‘I have a desire in you, and I am honourable to the women, so do not precede me (before someone else) with yourself’, and the secret is that he should not be alone with her when he promises her’.
en.sarwar: 4. Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hassan ibn Muhammad from more than one person from Aban from ‘Abd al-Rahman ibn abu ‘Abd Allah who has said the following:

“About the words of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, ‘. . . unless you speak in a lawful manner;’ [2:235] he (the Imam) said, ‘He meets her and says, “I am interested in you, I respect women, so you must not decide about yourself (to marry someone else) before me.” In “secret” dating he does not meet her as he had promised.’”
